personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK fused with 3 Editorial typography
personality_one_liner: A cinematic, suspenseful roulette experience where dark, macabre aesthetics meet premium, glass-layered native interaction.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards never flush to edge (use md/lg margin). Empty space is deliberate.

shadow_tier: 0 (Rely on blur, glass, and layered depth instead of traditional drop shadows per Glass/Luxe guidelines)

do's: Use glass for sticky headers over scrolling content
Use glass for bottom tab bar and bottom-sheet handles
Use glass overlays heavily on the Fate Card over the venue imagery
Combine blur with ≥75% tinted base underneath for readability
dont's: Never blur body text regions, form fields, or cards in dense lists
Avoid applying glass if it competes directly with another frosted surface (limit 2 per screen)

screens.name: Deal (Home)
screens.purpose: Configure constraints and commit to letting fate decide.

states.error: Failed to get location or connection error. Readable message + Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Safe-area respecting header with user location. Horizontally scrolling chip row for quick filters (Food, Drinks). Full-bleed layout where the primary 'DEAL' CTA is huge, pinned to the bottom thumb zone with a glass gradient behind it. Tapping 'Filters' opens a native bottom sheet (@gorhom/bottom-sheet) for price/distance.

screens.name: Shuffle + Reveal (Fate Card)
screens.purpose: Build suspense and deliver the chosen venue.

states.error: Oops, fate is blocked. Retry button.

screens.layout: Presented as a fullScreenModal. Phase 1: Reanimated shuffling cards (transforms and opacity for 60fps), triggered with rapid 'selection' haptics. Phase 2: Card lands, flips, and expands to full screen. The card is a full-bleed photo with a heavy bottom-to-top gradient scrim (0% transparent -> 90% surfaceInverse). Details (name, price, rating) and floating actions (Maps, Order) sit on the bottom 40% of the screen.

screens.name: Nearby
screens.purpose: Browse alternative results if fate's pick wasn't accepted.

states.empty: Grim Reaper illustration ('Fate found nothing in this wasteland') + clear filters CTA.
states.error: Error fetching nearby places + Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Standard scrolling grid (2 columns for compact cards or single column for detailed rows). Sticky header with segmented control / sort filters. Each card uses a brandTertiary tinted gradient for depth.

screens.name: Pub Crawl
screens.purpose: Build, track, and complete a multi-stop route.

states.empty: Illustration of empty glass/bar + 'Start a Crawl' primary CTA.
states.error: Failed to load route + Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Timeline view with vertical dashed connecting lines. Each stop is a row. Live progress tracking mode switches the active row to a 'Glass' elevated surface with a check-in button and live timer. Bottom of screen holds a sticky CTA for 'Share Code'.

screens.name: Leaderboard

states.empty: No one has survived this crawl yet. Be the first.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with segmented control (Global / This Week / This Crawl). Dense, readable list layout. Top 3 ranks have a subtle glass highlight or brandTertiary tint. User's own rank is pinned to the bottom above the tab bar.

fate_card_bg.alt: Dark cinematic restaurant interior for dark mode background

fate_card_bg_light.alt: Bright cocktail bar for light mode background

empty_state_reaper.alt: Shadowy figure in a cloak for macabre empty states

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the 'Glass / Luxe DARK' personality mixed with Editorial typography. Cormorant Garamond is for headings (max weight 500), Manrope is for body (max weight 500).
Ensure dark mode is the primary focus but follow the mapped colors for a clean Light Mode swap. Avoid pure black/white clashes.
For the Shuffle/Reveal interaction, utilize `react-native-reanimated` optimizing transform and opacity for 60fps. Bind Haptic feedback to the animation progress (see haptics map).
All Fate Cards (venue images) MUST have a heavy vertical gradient scrim (bottom to top, 0% to 90% opacity of surfaceInverse) to guarantee text legibility on top of the image.
Use @gorhom/bottom-sheet for the main 'Filter' sheet on the Deal Screen, integrating a glass handle and smooth native interaction.
Do NOT use any shades of blue, indigo, or purple. Stick to the Reaper Dark palette (Near black, greys, and the signature #E01E26 Red accent).
No emojis in the UI. Use Phosphor icons consistently.
Implement the 'DEAL' button as a sticky, full-width CTA pinned at the bottom, above the tab bar, surrounded by a glass overlay so scrollable content naturally flows behind it.
